correctness.rationale: For m uncovered vertices on each crown-graph side and c shared labels there are m²-c allowable edges. The c transition counts c(c-1),2c(m-c),(m-c)² sum exactly to the denominator and establish the displayed exact finite-size F(m,c) recurrence with F(1,1)=1,F(1,0)=0. If m>=2 then an available edge exists, so the only possible deficit is a single blocked diagonal pair. The normalized drift Y_m=C_m/[m(m+1)] and second factorial conditional moment lead to the stated nonnegative telescoping drift and harmonic bound, implying nq_n→2. Independent exact rational state recurrence and a separately defined labeled-vacancy subset recursion agreed through n=7, obtaining q2=0,q3=1/3,q4=q5=4/21,q6=172/1029,q7=4870/31899. These small enumerations corroborate the analytic n-uniform bound.
